reviews.rationale: Best of the tranche. It adds interpretation beyond the headline by decomposing the trade improvement into price and quantity effects, relies on two primary INDEC surfaces, and explicitly avoids turning one month into a structural conclusion.
required_before_real_approval: Confirm both INDEC URLs remain stable and accessible

reviews.rationale: Clear, useful and restrained. The piece does not overclaim from a single monthly print and distinguishes the observation from persistence. It is publishable as a short analytical note, though a richer version should add the core/regulated/seasonal decomposition.
required_before_real_approval: Optional: enrich with CPI composition if available

reviews.rationale: The signal is relevant and appears across two retail channels, but the current evidence surface is the INDEC homepage rather than the stable technical reports. The interpretation also needs context on income, employment or other consumption measures before it earns an analytical slot.
required_before_real_approval: Replace homepage citations with stable June technical-report URLs
Add at least one contextual measure before causal interpretation
